comment: FROZEN roll-site registry (MEDIUM-4). The registry is append-only: tests/test_rng_registry.py fails if any site here changes or vanishes (that would re-key historical dice). NEW sites must be appended here in the same commit with a reason. Sprint-2 baseline (documented pin change): action outcomes moved from the pooled ('character:<id>','action') stream to per-action-type streams, HOPELESS flavor draws got their own site, and chargen/timer-fire streams were registered unchanged.

action:craft.draws: one 2d6 outcome draw per resolved rollable action of this type; index advances via world_state.rng_counters

chargen.draws: six 2d6 draws at indexes 0..5, one per aptitude in APTITUDES order

hopeless_flavor.draws: one 2d6 draw per HOPELESS-band action; the roll picks the failure flavor only (never an outcome tier); index advances via world_state.rng_counters

timer_fire:training.draws: one 2d6 draw at index 0 per timer fire, seeded by timer_fire_seed(timer_key, created_event_id)
